title: Joshua Chapter 19 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Joshua chapter 19 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Joshua Chapter 19 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Joshua Chapter 19.

questions.question: To which tribe did the second lot come forth in Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: The second lot came forth to Simeon according to Joshua 19:1.

questions.question: Which city is included in the inheritance of the children of Simeon?
questions.explanation: Beersheba is listed as part of the inheritance of Simeon in Joshua 19:2.

questions.question: How many cities and their villages were given to the children of Simeon according to Joshua 19:6?
questions.explanation: Thirteen cities and their villages are assigned to Simeon in Joshua 19:6.

questions.question: True or False: The inheritance of the children of Simeon was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 and 19:9 state that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's inheritance.

questions.question: Which city marked the border of the inheritance of the children of Zebulun?
questions.explanation: The border of Zebulun's inheritance was unto Sarid as stated in Joshua 19:10.

questions.question: True or False: The border of Zebulun's inheritance reached to a river that is before Jokneam.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:11 mentions Zebulun's border reached to the river before Jokneam.

questions.question: Which city is NOT listed among the cities of Zebulun's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Ramath is not listed among Zebulun's cities but is mentioned elsewhere; Bethlehem is listed in Zebulun's inheritance in Joshua 19:15.

questions.question: What is the total number of cities given to the children of Zebulun with their villages?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:15 states there were twelve cities with their villages for Zebulun.

questions.question: Who received the fourth lot for their inheritance according to Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: The fourth lot came out to Issachar as stated in Joshua 19:17.

questions.question: Which city is mentioned as part of the border of the children of Issachar's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:18 lists Jezreel as part of Issachar's border.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Simeon had their inheritance outside the land of Judah.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 and 19:9 clarify that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's territory.

questions.question: Which of these cities was NOT part of the inheritance of Simeon?
questions.explanation: Sarid belonged to Zebulun's inheritance, not Simeon's, as seen in Joshua 19:10.

questions.question: In Joshua 19, which tribe's inheritance border went toward the sunrising (east) to the border of Chislothtabor?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:12 describes Zebulun's border turning east to Chislothtabor.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Issachar had sixteen cities with their villages.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:22 states Issachar had sixteen cities with their villages.

questions.question: In the order of lots given in Joshua 19, which tribe received their inheritance first?
questions.explanation: The first lot mentioned in this chapter was for Simeon (second lot overall), followed by Zebulun, then Issachar (Joshua 19:1, 19:10, 19:17).

medium.title: Joshua Chapter 19 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Joshua Chapter 19 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Which cities are included in the border of the children of Issachar according to Joshua 19:18-22?
options: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath
questions.correctAnswer: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath
questions.explanation: Verses Joshua 19:18-22 list the border cities of Issachar, including Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, and Anaharath, among others, defining the territory given to the tribe of Issachar.

questions.question: According to Joshua 19:24-31, which city is NOT part of the inheritance of the tribe of Asher?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:24-31 details the cities of Asher's inheritance, including Beten, Aphek, and Hebron. Zaanannim belongs to the children of Naphtali as per Joshua 19:33, not Asher.

questions.question: How does Joshua 19:27-29 illustrate God's provision and faithfulness in giving the tribes their inheritance?
options: By detailing the extensive borders reaching to well-known cities such as Tyre and Sidon
By emphasizing the need for military conquest for all territories
By granting the tribe of Dan a small and insufficient territory
By allocating inheritance only within the desert regions
questions.correctAnswer: By detailing the extensive borders reaching to well-known cities such as Tyre and Sidon
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:27-29 describes the vast borders of Asher's territory, reaching to notable cities like Tyre and Sidon, showing God's generous provision and faithfulness in fulfilling His promises.

questions.question: Which virtue does the inheritance division in Joshua 19:32-39 teach about God's order and faithfulness?
options: Integrity in following God's plan for distribution
Generosity in giving each tribe equal land
questions.correctAnswer: Integrity in following God's plan for distribution
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:32-39 shows the careful allotment of land to Naphtali according to God's direction, teaching integrity in obedience to God's plan and trust in His justice.

questions.question: According to Joshua 19:40-48, why did the children of Dan capture Leshem and rename it Dan?
options: Because their original territory was too small for them
To fulfill a prophecy about Dan
To unite with the tribe of Ephraim
Because it was their ancestral home
questions.correctAnswer: Because their original territory was too small for them
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:40-48 explains that the territory given to Dan was insufficient, so they fought for and captured Leshem, renaming it Dan after their father, showing faith and initiative in securing their inheritance.

questions.question: What lesson about faith and trust in God's provision can be drawn from Joshua 19:9 regarding the children of Simeon's inheritance?
options: They found their inheritance within Judah's because Judah's portion was too large
They conquered their land independently of God's plan
They refused to accept land within another tribe's territory
They received double the land because of their faith
questions.correctAnswer: They found their inheritance within Judah's because Judah's portion was too large
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:9 shows that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's because Judah's portion was too large, teaching trust in God's provision even when the inheritance is within another's territory.

questions.question: True or False: According to Joshua 19:50, Joshua the son of Nun received the city of Timnathserah in mount Ephraim as his inheritance.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:50 clearly states that Joshua asked for and was given the city of Timnathserah in mount Ephraim, which he built and dwelt in, confirming his inheritance.

questions.question: According to Joshua 19:34, which tribes bordered the children of Naphtali?
options: Zebulun to the south, Asher to the west, Judah to the east
Judah to the west, Ephraim to the south, Asher to the north
Zebulun to the north, Dan to the west, Issachar to the east
Asher to the south, Naphtali to the east, Simeon to the west
questions.correctAnswer: Zebulun to the south, Asher to the west, Judah to the east
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:34 describes the borders of Naphtali's inheritance touching Zebulun on the south side, Asher on the west, and Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising (east), showing precise geographical boundaries.

questions.question: What does the listing of multiple cities with their villages in Joshua 19:15 and 19:16 teach us about God's provision for the tribes?
options: God provides detailed and ample inheritance for each family within the tribes
The tribes were expected to conquer these cities themselves
Inheritance was only symbolic without actual land
The cities belonged only to the leaders, not the families
questions.correctAnswer: God provides detailed and ample inheritance for each family within the tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:15-16 lists twelve cities and their villages for Zebulun, demonstrating God's thorough and generous provision for each tribe and family, ensuring they had sufficient land.

questions.question: True or False: Joshua 19:41-46 lists the coast of the children of Dan including cities such as Shaalabbin and Ekron.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:41-46 details the cities in Dan's inheritance, including Shaalabbin and Ekron among others, confirming the extent of their territory.

questions.question: How does the passage in Joshua 19:28-30 demonstrate God's generosity to the tribe of Asher?
options: By giving them 22 cities with their villages stretching to notable coastal cities
By giving them only a few desert cities
By merging their land with the tribe of Dan
By limiting their inheritance to mountain regions
questions.correctAnswer: By giving them 22 cities with their villages stretching to notable coastal cities
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:28-30 describes Asher's inheritance as including 22 cities with their villages, reaching to important coastal cities like Tyre and Achzib, showing God's abundant provision.

questions.question: What spiritual lesson can be drawn from the fact that the children of Dan had to fight for Leshem as noted in Joshua 19:47?
options: Sometimes we must actively pursue what God has promised us with courage and faith
God's promises are only fulfilled through peaceful means
Inheritance is always given without effort
Conquest is unnecessary when trusting God
questions.correctAnswer: Sometimes we must actively pursue what God has promised us with courage and faith
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 shows that the children of Dan found their original inheritance too small and had to fight for Leshem, teaching that faith sometimes requires action and trust in God's strength during challenges.

questions.question: True or False: Joshua 19:23 confirms that the cities and villages listed belong to the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:23 explicitly states that the inheritance described is for the tribe of Issachar according to their families, confirming the allotment of cities and villages.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the inheritance boundaries of the children of Issachar as detailed in Joshua 19:18-22?
options: Borders include Jezreel, Tabor, and the Jordan River
Borders are limited to the coastal cities only
Inheritance lies entirely within the desert
Borders extend to the city of Leshem exclusively
questions.correctAnswer: Borders include Jezreel, Tabor, and the Jordan River
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:18-22 describes Issachar's borders including Jezreel, Tabor, and ending at the Jordan River, illustrating the extent and fertility of the land given to them.

questions.question: What does the detailed listing of cities and borders in Joshua 19 teach us about the importance of order and integrity in dividing God's blessings?
options: God expects His people to distribute blessings carefully and fairly according to His instructions
Inheritance was given randomly without guidelines
Only the strongest tribes received land
The land was divided without regard to family or tribe
questions.correctAnswer: God expects His people to distribute blessings carefully and fairly according to His instructions
questions.explanation: Joshua 19 shows the detailed and careful division of land by lot according to families and tribes, highlighting the need for integrity, order, and faithfulness to God's commands in sharing His blessings.

hard.title: Joshua Chapter 19 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Joshua Chapter 19.

questions.question: Which of the following cities was included in the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali?
questions.explanation: Ziddim is listed as one of the fenced cities in the inheritance of Naphtali (Joshua 19:35). Beersheba belongs to Simeon (Joshua 19:2), Jezreel to Issachar (Joshua 19:18), and Helkath to Asher (Joshua 19:25).

questions.question: What reason is given for the children of Dan taking Leshem and renaming it Dan?
options: Their coast was too little for them
They desired a city near the sea
It was the original city of their father
The city was a religious center
questions.correctAnswer: Their coast was too little for them
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 explains that the coast of Dan was too little for them, so they went to fight and took Leshem, renaming it Dan after their father.

questions.question: According to Joshua 19, who received an inheritance among the Israelites after the tribal allotments were completed?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:49-50 states that after the division, Joshua the son of Nun was given an inheritance, specifically the city Timnathserah in mount Ephraim.

questions.question: Which city was given to Joshua the son of Nun as his inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:50 specifies that Joshua was given the city Timnathserah in mount Ephraim, which he built and dwelt in.

questions.question: How many cities with their villages did the tribe of Naphtali receive according to Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:38 mentions nineteen cities with their villages as the inheritance of Naphtali.

questions.question: Which tribe's inheritance included the city of Zorah?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:41 lists Zorah as part of the inheritance of the tribe of Dan.

questions.question: Which tribe's inheritance bordered the Jordan river according to Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:22 states that the outgoings of Issachar's border were at the Jordan river.

questions.question: What literary device can be identified in the listing of cities and their villages repeatedly throughout Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: The repeated phrase 'cities with their villages' at the beginning and end of each tribal section creates an inclusio, framing each inheritance description (Joshua 19:6, 19:15, 19:31, 19:39, 19:48).

questions.question: Which city in Joshua 19 is associated with a significant Old Testament event involving Elijah and the prophets of Baal (1 Kings 18)?
questions.explanation: Jezreel, mentioned in Joshua 19:18 as part of Issachar's inheritance, is known from 1 Kings 18 as the site of Elijah's confrontation with the prophets of Baal.

questions.question: The Hebrew word for 'inheritance' used in Joshua 19 often relates to what concept in the Old Testament?
options: Land given by God as a covenantal promise
questions.correctAnswer: Land given by God as a covenantal promise
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for 'inheritance' (nachalah) in Joshua 19 refers to land allotted by God to His people, fulfilling the covenant promise to Abraham and his descendants (Genesis 15:18-21).

questions.question: True or False: The inheritance of the tribe of Simeon was entirely separate from the inheritance of Judah.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 and 19:9 state that the inheritance of Simeon was within the inheritance of Judah, as Judah's portion was too large.

questions.question: True or False: The division of land was completed at Shiloh before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:51 confirms that the land division was completed in Shiloh before the LORD at the tabernacle's door.

questions.question: Which tribe's inheritance included the city of Hazor, a city later significant in the conquest narratives?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:36 mentions Hazor as one of the cities in the inheritance of Naphtali. Hazor was a major Canaanite city conquered later in the book of Joshua (Joshua 11:10-13).

questions.question: Which city was NOT part of the inheritance of Asher according to Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: Leshem was taken by the tribe of Dan (Joshua 19:47). Tyre, Achzib, and Hebron are listed in Asher's inheritance (Joshua 19:29, 19:30, 19:28).

questions.question: The division of land by lot in Joshua 19 echoes which Old Testament practice emphasizing God's sovereignty over land distribution?
options: The casting of lots for Achan's sin (Joshua 7)
The division of land among the clans of Judah (Numbers 26)
questions.correctAnswer: The casting of lots for Achan's sin (Joshua 7)
questions.explanation: Casting lots as in Joshua 19:51 echoes earlier practices like the casting of lots for Achan's sin in Joshua 7:14-18, underscoring God's control over Israel's affairs.

theological.title: Joshua Chapter 19 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Joshua Chapter 19 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does the fact that the children of Simeon received their inheritance within the territory of Judah reveal about God's provision and distribution of land?
options: God's provision can overlap to meet the needs of His people
The Simeonites were subordinate to Judah
God was indifferent to tribal boundaries
The land was insufficient for all tribes
questions.correctAnswer: God's provision can overlap to meet the needs of His people
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 and 19:9 show that the inheritance of Simeon was within Judah's land because Judah's portion was too large. This reveals God's providential arrangement to ensure all tribes were adequately provided for, demonstrating His care and sovereignty in land distribution.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by the detailed allotment of cities and villages to each tribe as seen throughout Joshua 19?
questions.explanation: The precise division of land and cities (e.g., Joshua 19:10-15, 19:24-31) reflects God's justice in fairly allotting inheritance to each tribe according to their families, ensuring equitable treatment among His people.

questions.question: According to Joshua 19:50, what significant action did Joshua take upon receiving his inheritance?
options: He built the city and dwelt therein
He sold the city to another tribe
He gave the city to the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: He built the city and dwelt therein
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:50 states that Joshua received Timnathserah as his inheritance and built the city, then dwelt there. This shows Joshua's role as both leader and settler, fulfilling God's promise to him.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is illustrated by the children of Dan conquering Leshem and renaming it Dan as described in Joshua 19:47?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 describes how Dan took Leshem by force and renamed it after their father, showing the fulfillment of God's covenant promise to give the land to Israel through conquest and possession.

questions.question: How does the inheritance of Naphtali, including fortified cities, reflect God's provision for security among His people?
options: God ensures both land and protection
God grants cities only to priests
God requires tribes to build walls themselves
questions.correctAnswer: God ensures both land and protection
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:35-38 lists fortified cities for Naphtali, indicating that God's provision includes not only land but also security for His people, emphasizing His protective care.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal insight do Joshua 19:24-31 and Joshua 19:32-39 provide about God's covenantal faithfulness?
options: God faithfully allocates land to each tribe according to His promise
God's blessings are based on tribal size
God favors some tribes over others
God's covenant is conditional on conquest success
questions.correctAnswer: God faithfully allocates land to each tribe according to His promise
questions.explanation: Both passages detail the inheritances of Asher and Naphtali, showing God's faithfulness in fulfilling His covenant promises by dividing the land among all tribes according to their families.

questions.question: Sceptics claim the division of land in Joshua 19 shows arbitrary tribal favoritism. What does Joshua 19:17-23 actually teach about God's allocation of inheritance?
options: God distributes inheritance equitably based on families within tribes
God arbitrarily chooses some tribes for greater land
Tribal leaders decide land allocation by strength
The children of Issachar received no inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: God distributes inheritance equitably based on families within tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:17-23 describes the inheritance for Issachar according to their families, demonstrating an orderly and fair distribution by God's direction, not favoritism or arbitrariness.

questions.question: What does the allocation of cities with their villages to each tribe indicate about the nature of sanctification in the Old Testament community?
options: Sanctification involved communal living within God's appointed boundaries
Sanctification was an individual pursuit only
Sanctification was unrelated to land possession
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification involved communal living within God's appointed boundaries
questions.explanation: The repeated mention of cities with their villages (e.g., Joshua 19:6, 19:15, 19:22) highlights the communal and territorial aspect of holiness, where God's people lived set apart within designated inheritance.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted by the phrase 'according to their families' repeated throughout Joshua 19 in the land allotments?
questions.explanation: The phrase 'according to their families' (e.g., Joshua 19:1, 19:10, 19:17) reveals God's attribute of orderliness in administering justice and provision within the community.

questions.question: How do the borders described for Zebulun in Joshua 19:10-15 connect to the broader biblical narrative of God's promise to Israel?
options: They fulfill God's promise to give Israel specific land boundaries
They show Israel's failure to take the land
They indicate the land was already occupied by enemies
They demonstrate God's rejection of Zebulun
questions.correctAnswer: They fulfill God's promise to give Israel specific land boundaries
questions.explanation: The detailed borders of Zebulun reflect the fulfillment of God's promise to Abraham and his descendants to give them a specific land (Genesis 15:18), as part of the covenantal inheritance.

questions.question: What does the inclusion of Timnathserah as Joshua’s inheritance (Joshua 19:49-50) teach about God’s faithfulness to His leaders in redemptive history?
options: God rewards faithful leadership with blessing and provision
Leaders receive no reward in this life
Land inheritance was only for priests
Joshua's inheritance was given by human decision alone
questions.correctAnswer: God rewards faithful leadership with blessing and provision
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:49-50 shows that after the land was divided, Joshua was given Timnathserah as promised by God, signifying divine reward and faithfulness to those who lead His people.

questions.question: Combining Joshua 19:41-46 and 19:47, what do these passages teach about God's provision and human responsibility in possessing the promised land?
options: God provides the inheritance but requires active possession and conquest
God gives the land without any human effort
Human conquest is discouraged by God
Inheritance is symbolic only, not literal
questions.correctAnswer: God provides the inheritance but requires active possession and conquest
questions.explanation: Verses 41-46 list the territory of Dan, but verse 47 shows Dan’s need to fight for Leshem to possess it, teaching that God's provision requires human responsibility to claim and secure His promises.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth about God's covenantal faithfulness is illustrated by the comprehensive allotment of land to all tribes before the tabernacle at Shiloh (Joshua 19:51)?
options: God faithfully fulfills His promises publicly and orderly
The tabernacle was irrelevant to land allocation
The division was chaotic and unplanned
questions.correctAnswer: God faithfully fulfills His promises publicly and orderly
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:51 states the division was done before the LORD at the tabernacle door, showing God’s faithfulness in publicly and orderly fulfilling His covenant promises to Israel.

questions.question: What does the inclusion of cities like Tyre and Sidon within Asher’s border (Joshua 19:29) signify in the context of God's sovereign rule over the nations?
options: God’s sovereignty extends over all peoples and territories
God’s kingdom was limited to Israel only
Tyre and Sidon were excluded from divine rule
questions.correctAnswer: God’s sovereignty extends over all peoples and territories
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:29 includes strong cities like Tyre and Sidon in Asher’s border, symbolizing that God's sovereign rule encompasses nations beyond Israel, foreshadowing the universal scope of His kingdom.

questions.question: How do the detailed border descriptions for Naphtali in Joshua 19:33-34 illustrate the attribute of God’s immanence in the life of His people?
options: God is intimately involved in the precise lives and territories of His people
God is distant from earthly matters
God leaves His people to govern themselves without guidance
God’s presence is only in the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: God is intimately involved in the precise lives and territories of His people
questions.explanation: The precise territorial boundaries given for Naphtali (Joshua 19:33-34) indicate God's immanence, reflecting His close involvement and care in the daily lives and land of His covenant people.
